kycPage.pageDescription: Where you stand, what you'll need and how long it takes.
kycPage.verifiedBody: Identity confirmed. There are no limits on your payments and the verified badge shows on your checkout.
kycPage.reviewBody: We've received your documents. Most reviews finish within minutes, at most 24–48 hours. We'll email you and add a notification the moment it's done — nothing else to do here.
kycPage.retryBody: Your last attempt couldn't be approved — usually a blurry photo or a mismatched name. You can go again right away.
kycPage.retryBodyReason: Your last attempt couldn't be approved: {{reason}}. You can go again right away.
kycPage.blockedBody: You passed {{threshold}} in volume and the grace period has ended, so new payments are paused. Finish the quick check below to resume.
kycPage.neededBody: You passed {{threshold}} in payment volume, so regulations require a quick identity check. Payments keep flowing while you complete it.
kycPage.notNeededBody: Identity verification becomes required once your payment volume reaches {{threshold}}. You can verify early to unlock the verified badge.
kycPage.needSubtitle: Have these ready and the whole thing takes a few minutes.
kycPage.docIdDesc: Passport, driver's licence or national ID card — valid and not expired.
kycPage.docAddressDesc: A utility bill, bank statement or government letter from the last 3 months.
kycPage.docSelfieDesc: A live photo so we can match you to your ID. Good light, no hat or glasses.
kycPage.how1: Tap Continue — you'll go to our verification partner Veriff.
kycPage.how2: Photograph your ID and take a selfie with your phone or webcam.
kycPage.how3: Come back here. We email you and add a notification when the result is in.
kycPage.partnerNote: Verified securely by Veriff. Dynopay never stores your ID images.
